runtime_status_authority: PostgreSQL execution, review and deployment records

requirements.scope: Versioned spec, AC, human-confirmed core journeys and scope
requirements.acceptance: Every executable scenario links explicit expected outcomes and a reviewed spec revision; unknown intent remains unresolved.
Generated drafts retain source AC links, normal/error/cancel/recovery paths and human review; generation never creates execution evidence.

requirements.scope: Authoritative stage progression and dependency invalidation
requirements.acceptance: Actual evaluator receipts and revision-bound approvals gate progression; upstream spec/code/environment changes invalidate affected approvals.
Failure returns to the responsible stage; bounded implementation repair preserves approved expected outcomes and historical failures.

requirements.scope: Five development teams plus research and improvement
requirements.acceptance: Each active role has routing, authority, execution, review and recovery paths; implementation and final verification are independent.

requirements.scope: One Device port for MCP, agent, REPL and E2E
requirements.acceptance: All clients use the same action semantics, capability checks, exclusive lease and artifact capture; stale owner actions are rejected.
Human takeover pauses agent writes; action ownership, intervention and resume are recorded.

requirements.scope: Measured device execution to E2E code and replay
requirements.acceptance: A complete real-device scenario generates a reviewed executable test which passes a fresh full run after verified reset; resumed/debug runs do not count as fresh acceptance.
Action, UI and backend traces produce source-linked drafts; missing actions or human intent are never invented.
Builds, device/OS/driver, configuration and data/reset procedure are recorded; real dependencies or official test services execute; missing infrastructure is unverified.
Amounts, currency, fees, rounding, duplicates, ambiguous outcomes, cancellation/refund, permissions and actual transaction state are tested; uncertain actions are reconciled before retry.
People can inspect journey graphs, expected-versus-observed results, changes and source evidence; approve only a specific revision and evidence set.

requirements.scope: shadcn/ui, Lucide and semantic CSS variable tokens
requirements.acceptance: Product and stories share components; color/type/spacing/radius/shadow/layer/motion and theme tokens are versioned; package versions are pinned at implementation.
Required states, boundaries, responsive/accessibility behavior and business flows map to AC; component demos never certify real-service acceptance.
Lifecycle boundaries link trace/task/session/generation/revision/evidence; sensitive data is removed and mandatory audit events are not sampled away.
Independent monitoring detects missing ACK, heartbeat, receipts, sequence gaps, queue deadlines and logging-system failures without treating active tools as idle.
Pending/delivered/acknowledged/resolved are distinct; dedup preserves recurrence evidence; failed delivery retries durably; normal cases do not alert.
Pinned inventories, scoped source/caller analysis, executed tests, explicit gaps and independent adoption decisions cover Baldrix, harness/guardian, Hermes, Ouroboros and other tracked references.

requirements.scope: Existing architecture, SSOT, GraphRAG and six-W contracts
requirements.acceptance: New modules preserve hexagonal boundaries, Git definitions/PostgreSQL runtime authority and derived graph provenance; code comments cite non-obvious contracts.

requirements.scope: 70% handoff, idle lifecycle and resource scheduling
requirements.acceptance: Handoff persists evidence and fences old writers; idle shutdown respects active tools/device leases and bus wakeup obeys resource budgets.

requirements.scope: Second independent recurrence becomes mandatory hook improvement
requirements.acceptance: Reproduction and normal-case tests, independent review and actual CLI canary precede activation; no bypassing gates.

requirements.scope: Astra to guarded Sol to guarded Terra transfer
requirements.acceptance: Task-family/version-bound equivalent behavior is demonstrated; unqualified work stays Astra; failure escalates to the qualified predecessor.
Exact candidate and incumbent validation plus actual Codex CLI startup/file-task canary precede release; post-release failures trigger measured recovery.

implementation_batches.exit: Reviewable spec/AC/scenario chain and shared component stories; observational evidence remains distinct from approval.
One approved target app on one real device with reset, single-owner control and durable evidence/notifications.
One human-approved core journey runs end-to-end, generates E2E code and passes fresh replay without mocks or changed expectations.
Activate team routes with reviewed gates, observed resource limits and actual release canary; run the eight-stage iteration.
Expand proven scenarios and device coverage; continue source migration and incident-driven improvements without repository-wide completion overclaims.

open_execution_inputs: First target application, repository and human owner of its acceptance criteria
Required platforms and actual device/provider access; Device Farm SDK product is not yet selected
Official test accounts, real dependency endpoints and reset procedure
External notification channel recipients if needed; first channel is the local/LAN VIEW
completion_rule: Definition recorded is not implementation, verification, human acceptance or deployment. Each requires its own evidence.
